decisions.reason: As the flagship digital app aligned with the firm's strategic direction and core software, its option value remains high and drop probability is very low.
The continuing education institute leverages existing customer relationships and mandatory training demand, so the option is worth keeping despite some uncertainty.
This support tool is low-cost and complements the core offering, making the option inexpensive to keep open.
The analytics dashboard addresses growing demand for data-driven practice management, so its option value justifies continued investment.
Bundling existing products into a complete practice package is a low-cost option that may increase sales, so it is kept.
The job and practice listing portal is outside the core software business, likely costly to maintain, and its network benefits have not been established, making its option value too low to keep.
